Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1) Functional Requirements:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Crawl the web starting from a given set of seed URLs.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Extract text data from each web page and store the text for later processing.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: --- out of scope -------

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The actual processing of the text data (e.g., training an LLM).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Handling of non-text data (e.g., images, videos, etc.).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Handling of dynamic content (e.g., JavaScript-rendered pages).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Handling of authentication (e.g., login-required pages).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) Questions to ask about Scale: how many web pages are there. the size of each webpage.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - 10B web pages

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - 2MB per page

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - 5 days to scrape

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Non Functional Requirements (SPARCS):

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - fault tolerance to handle failures gracefully and resume crawling without losing progress.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Politeness to adhere to robots.txt and not overload website servers inappropriately.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Efficiency to crawl the web in under 5 days.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Scalability to handle 10B pages.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4) BOE Calculations: -- to be updated right now with dummy data

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Load / Traffic (QPS)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Write QPS : 1*(1M Bookings)/ (10^5) => 10

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Peak QPS

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Approximate: Peak QPS ≈ 3000 (Read) / 30 (Write)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Storage

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Daily storage = 1M daily writes × 1 KB average request = 1 GB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Yearly storage = 1 GB × 365 = 365 GB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Total storage (5-year plan)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Total storage = 365 GB × 5 = 1.82 TB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Total physical storage ≈ 1.82 TB × 3 = 5.46 TB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Bandwidth

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Ingress = 10 write QPS × 1 KB average write = 10 KB/s

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Egress = 1000 read QPS × 100 KB average read = 100 MB/s

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Cache

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > 100M daily read requests × 100 KB× 0.20 = 2 TB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5) Core Entities

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - text data

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6) API/ system interface

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: For data processing system design questions like this one, it helps to start by defining the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: system's interface. This includes clearly outline what data the system receives and what it

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: outputs, establishing a clear boundary of the system's functionality.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Input: Seed URLs to start crawling from

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Output: text data extracted from web pages.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 7) Data Flow

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: sequential series of steps we'll cover in order to get from the inputs to our system to the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: outputs.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Take seed URL from frontier and request IP from DNS

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Fetch HTML from external server using IP

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Extract text data from the HTML.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Store the text data in a database.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Extract any linked URLs from the web pages and add them to the list of URLs to crawl.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Repeat steps 1-5 until all URLs have been crawled.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Design Web Crawler

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Design

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Potential Deep Dives

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: High Level Design

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Deep Dive

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: A web crawler is a program that automatically traverses the web by downloading web pages and following links from one page to another. It is used to index the web for search engines, collect

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: data for research, or monitor websites for changes.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Questions to ask:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - what is the type of webcrawler

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: design a web crawler whose goal is to extract text data from the web to train an LLM.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Your crawler can run for only 5 days.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Key Concepts on the go

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1) Robot.txt file: simple text file placed at the root of a website that provides

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: instructions to web crawlers about which parts of the site they can or cannot crawl and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: index, helping manage server load and control search engine access to private or

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: unimportant content.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - User-agent: *

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Disallow: /private/

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Crawl-delay: 10

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) why not directly pushing the html to the second queue- due to size constraints hence

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: we are pushing the s3 link.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Kafka vs SQS, Dead Letter Queue

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4) Another good point to note is always keep scaling deep dive for the last. This is

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: because you'll have a clearer picture of the full system and can make more informed

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: decisions about where to scale.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1) fault tolerance: Currently our crawler service is doing ton of work. we will start by breaking up

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the work.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - URL Fetcher:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Take seed URL from frontier and request IP from DNS

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Fetch HTML from external server using IP

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Stores raw html to blob for later processing.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Text & Url extraction:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > extracts text data from html

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > extracts url to add to the frontier queue.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) Failing to fetch URL

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - bad Solution: Manual timer

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - good solution: Kafka with manual exponential backoff

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > kafka doest support exponential backoff so we do that part manually. We could have a

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: separate topic for failed URLs and a separate service that reads from this topic and retries the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: fetch with exponential backoff. In order to know how much to backoff, we could store the time

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: that the next fetch should occur in the message itself. When a consumer reads a message, it will

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: check the time and if it is in the future, it will wait until that time to retry the fetch.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Great Solution: SQS with exponential backoff

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > further we dont want to retry indefinitely. After certain failures we move to a dead-letter

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: queue (DLQ).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) what if web crawler goes down

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Kafka retains messages in a log and does not remove them even after they are read. Crawlers

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: track their progress via offsets, which are not updated in Kafka until the URL is successfully

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: fetched and processed. If a crawler fails, the next one picks up right where the last one left off,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ensuring no data is lost.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - With SQS, messages remain in the queue until they are explicitly deleted. A visibility timeout hides

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: a message from other crawlers once it's fetched. If the crawler fails before confirming successful

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: processing, the message will automatically become visible again after the timeout expires, allowing

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: another crawler to attempt the fetch. On the other hand, once the HTML is stored in blob

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: storage, the crawler will delete the message from the queue, ensuring it is not processed again.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4) Ensuring Politeness & adherence to robots.txt

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Always check and store each domain's robots.txt before crawling.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Use robots.txt rules to decide:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > If a URL is disallowed = acknowledge and drop it.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > If allowed - also read any Crawl-delay value.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Keep a Domain Table in a metadata database to store, per domain:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Parsed robots.txt rules.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > The last time you crawled that domain.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - When a URL is pulled from the queue:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > If disallowed - ack and skip.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > If allowed but crawl-delay not yet passed - put it back on the queue with a delay (e.g., SQS

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: DelaySeconds).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > If crawl-delay passed - crawl the page and update the domain's last-crawl time.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Enforce a global per-domain rate limit (e.g., 1 request per second) using a central store like Redis

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: with a sliding-window counter per domain.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - If the per-domain limit is hit, wait before sending another request.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Add small random delays (jitter) so multiple crawlers don't all retry at exactly the same time and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: collide on the same domain.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5) Scaling a Web Crawler to 10B Pages in Under 5 Days

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Crawling is I/O intensive; with 2MB avg page size and a 200 Gbps network-optimized AWS

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: instance, theoretical max is ~12,500 pages/sec.nRealistic utilization ~30% due to latency, DNS,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: rate limits, retries, politeness -> ~3,750 pages/sec per machine.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Math: 10B pages / 3,750 pages/sec = 30.9 days on one machine; ~8 machines brings it under 5

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: days (~3.9 days).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Per-domain rate limit (1 req/sec) is bypassed in aggregate by crawling millions of domains in parallel

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: with thousands of concurrent connections.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Parser workers: auto-scale dynamically (Lambda, ECS Fargate) based on Further Processing Queue

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: depth instead of pre-sizing.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - DNS is a hidden bottleneck - Mercator paper found up to 70% of thread time spent on DNS

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: lookups.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Mitigations: DNS caching in crawlers, multiple DNS providers with round-robin, custom resolver,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: or paid rate limit increases.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - URL-level deduplication: check Metadata DB before enqueueing to skip already-crawled URLs.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Content-level deduplication: hash fetched page content to catch identical content across

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: different URLs/domains.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Option 1: Store hash in Metadata DB with an index - simple and practical; modern DB indexes

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: handle scale well.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Option 2: Bloom filter (e.g., Redis + RedisBloom, BF.ADD/BF.EXISTS) - memory-efficient but

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: allows false positives; often overkill.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Crawler traps: pages that loop or self-link infinitely. Mitigate with a max link-hop depth (15-20),

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: tracked in the URL table.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Additional deep dives to consider:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Dynamic content: render JS-heavy sites with headless browsers (Puppeteer).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Monitoring: Datadog/New Relic for crawler and parser health, alerting.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Large files: send HTTP HEAD first, skip if Content-Length exceeds threshold (e.g., 10MB).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Continual updates: add a URL Scheduler component to recrawl based on last crawl time,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: popularity, etc.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Priority crawling: multiple SQS queues by priority; Kafka needs separate topics per priority

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: level.
